sections.title: A.1 Qualitative Results and Challenging Cases
A.3 The Use of Large Language Models (LLMs) Statement

abstract_sentences.text: Recent developments in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly improved Vision–Language (VL) reasoning in 2D domains.

evidence.anchor: improved Vision–Language reasoning in 2D domains

abstract_sentences.text: However, extending these capabilities to 3D scene understanding remains a major challenge.

evidence.anchor: extending these capabilities to 3D scene understanding remains a major challenge

abstract_sentences.text: Existing 3D Multimodal Large Language Models (3D-MLLMs) often depend on 3D data inputs, which limits scalability and generalization.

evidence.anchor: depend on 3D data inputs, which limits scalability and generalization

abstract_sentences.text: To address this limitation, we propose Vid-LLM, a video-based 3D-MLLM that directly processes video inputs without requiring external 3D data, making it practical for real-world deployment.

evidence.anchor: directly processes video inputs without requiring external 3D data

abstract_sentences.text: In our method, the geometric prior are directly used to improve the performance of the sceen perception.

evidence.anchor: the geometric prior are directly used to improve the performance

abstract_sentences.text: To integrate the geometric cues into the MLLM compactly, we design a Cross-Task Adapter (CTA) module to align the 3D geometric priors with the vision-language representations.

evidence.anchor: design a Cross-Task Adapter (CTA) module to align the 3D geometric priors

abstract_sentences.text: To ensure geometric consistency and integrity, we introduce a Metric Depth Model that recovers real-scale geometry from the reconstruction outputs.

evidence.anchor: Metric Depth Model that recovers real-scale geometry

abstract_sentences.text: Finally, the model is fine-tuned with a two-stage distillation optimization strategy, realizing fast convergence and stabilizes training.

evidence.anchor: two-stage distillation optimization strategy

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks verified the effectiveness of our method on 3D Question Answering, 3D Dense Captioning and 3D Visual Grounding tasks, demonstrating the superior multi-task capabilities.

evidence.anchor: 3D Question Answering, 3D Dense Captioning and 3D Visual Grounding tasks
language as a universal interface ... grounding language in persistent 3D spatial representations
depth, poses, or external modules ... limit the scalability and transferability
reconstruction and reasoning are intrinsically interdependent
jointly performs reconstruction and 3D vision–language reasoning from monocular video inputs
Our main contributions are summarized as follows
Existing approaches predominantly rely on explicit geometric inputs ... VGLLM
3D reconstruction has evolved from multi-view geometry pipelines ... weakly integrated into vision–language research

final_judgment.single_storyline: 单目视频 → shared DINOv2 → CTA/Bridge Tokens 的几何/语义交换 → camera/depth/metric scale → 3D patch → LLM reasoning；Stage 1 dual-teacher 与 Stage 2 joint loss 使该链可训练。[pp. 2–6, §§1–3, explicit]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留输入边界、CTA、Metric Depth/scale alignment、3D back-projection、两阶段损失、三类 VL 结果、joint-vs-concatenation 对照和局部消融。[pp. 2–10, §§1–5, interpretation]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: A.1 放定性结果和失败，A.2 放 pose/depth/point-cloud 表，A.3 放 LLM statement；中心 VL 结果仍可在正文阅读，但 standalone reconstruction 与失败边界需要附录。[pp. 17–20, Appendix, explicit/interpretation]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig. 2 的端到端数据流、Fig. 3 的训练阶段图、Table 5 的尺度/耦合/速度三重对照、Table 6 的 CTA/MD/token/training 消融共同把组件连接到决策结果。[pp. 4–6、9–10, Figs. 2–3/Tables 5–6, interpretation]
final_judgment.largest_gap: 论文将 reconstruction–reasoning 描述为 mutually reinforcing，但 Stage 2 明确规定 3D-VL loss 不优化 reconstruction model；该设计支持受限 feature exchange，却没有直接识别语义反过来改善几何的因果效果，Fig. 5 也没有 seed/方差。[p. 6, §3.4；p. 10, Fig. 5, explicit/interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 共享几何/语义主张应同时提供无交互或简单串接、relative-vs-metric scale、组件删除/替代交互消融，并在同表报告任务分数与推理成本；Table 5–6 是可复用模板。[pp. 9–10, Tables 5–6, interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合有中间几何表征和多任务输出的视觉系统；本文证据仅覆盖列出的真实/室内数据、单目视频、Mask3D/segmentation 条件和指标，不能推出开放世界、室外长视频、端到端实例发现或部署 SLA。[pp. 7、17–20, §§4.1/A.1–A.2, explicit/not_present]
